# aah.monster
> High-performance prompt engineering engine and tactical AI workflow builder.

## Core Capabilities
- Automated Prompt Optimization: De-biasing, instruction-following hardening.
- Tactical AI Templates: Production-ready templates for engineering, marketing, and research.
- Evaluation Harnesses: Benchmark prompt variants against real-world test sets.
